messages.content: "Can you tell me how many active players were engaged with the video game 'Call of Duty: Modern Warfare' in the year 2019 on the 'Playstation' platform, and then compare that with the number of active players for the same game in the year 2020 on the 'PC' platform? Also, could you provide the sales figures for 'Call of Duty: Modern Warfare' for the year 2019 on the 'Playstation' platform and then for the year 2020 on the 'PC' platform?"

function.name: video_games_get_player_count
function.description: Retrieves the number of active players for a specified video game and year. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

game_title.description: The title of the video game.

platform.description: The gaming platform (e.g. 'PC', 'Xbox', 'Playstation'). Default is all if not specified.

function.name: video_games_get_sales
function.description: Retrieves the sales figures for a specified video game and year. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

game_title.description: The title of the video game.

platform.description: The gaming platform (e.g. 'PC', 'Xbox', 'Playstation'). Default is all if not specified.

message.reasoning:
We need to call two functions: video_games_get_player_count twice, and video_games_get_sales twice.

First request: active players for Call of Duty: Modern Warfare in 2019 on Playstation. Then compare with active players for same game in 2020 on PC. So we need player counts for both.

Second request: sales figures for 2019 on Playstation, and 2020 on PC.

Thus four calls.

We should do them sequentially or maybe combine? We can call each separately. We'll use the function calls.

We'll produce JSON calls. Let's do first call: video_games_get_player_count with game_title "Call of Duty: Modern Warfare", year 2019, platform "Playstation". Then second call: same but year 2020, platform "PC".

Then third call: video_games_get_sales with game_title "Call of Duty: Modern Warfare", year 2019, platform "Playstation". Fourth call: video_games_get_sales with game_title "Call of Duty: Modern Warfare", year 2020, platform "PC".

We need to output calls as separate messages. Probably best to do one after another. We'll produce calls in order.
